title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2610.13917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions

translated_title: 从自然语言设计蛋白质结构
translated_abstract: 从头蛋白质设计的一个核心挑战是生成具有所需结构和功能特性的蛋白质。现有的设计模型通常需要为每种特性提供专门的输入表示，这限制了它们所支持的设计目标。我们开发了Prompteina，这是首个支持以自然语言指定的新型、更广泛设计目标的全原子结构生成模型，类似于文本到图像的生成。为了训练Prompteina，我们构建了Prompteina-Data数据集，这是一个文本—蛋白质结构配对数据集，包含180万个结构和超过5000万条描述全局及残基特异性结构与功能特性的文本说明。我们通过文本条件预训练和微调，将残基与其对应的文本对齐，从而适配预训练的结构生成模型Proteina-Complexa。Prompteina在18项结构特性中的15项上超越了基线模型，并生成了与文本描述更加匹配的蛋白质。
tldr: 该论文提出首个支持自然语言指令的全原子蛋白质结构生成模型Prompteina，通过构建包含180万结构和5000多万条文本说明的配对数据集进行训练，实现了类似“文本生成图像”的蛋白质设计范式，并在18项结构特性中的15项上超越现有基线模型。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Prompteina, the first all-atom protein structure generation model that supports natural language design objectives, trained on a paired text-protein dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions, outperforming baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties.
